rule: Profit or loss on one card. If it is sold, the realised sale price against what was paid. Otherwise the current comp value against what was paid. A missing figure counts as zero, so an unvalued card reads as a loss of its cost rather than as break-even.

cases.why: unrealised gain on a held card
realised: the sale price wins and comp value is ignored
sold with no price recorded is a total loss, not a gain from comp
no comp value yet reads as a loss of cost
listed but unsold is still valued at comp
a gift or unrecorded cost counts as free
